name: Mirror | Mirror
source:
Mirror | Mirror is a psychological horror visual novel, where you are stuck in a bathroom haunted by a reflection.  

Find a way to leave the bathroom — YOU CAN’T BE CONTAINED HERE — and stop the loop — EVERYTHING COMES TO AN END.

[From [url=https://manifesto-propaganda.itch.io/mirrormirror]itch.io[/url]]
